evidence.distinctiveness: Structure comes from the product: dark tablet keypad beside a paper record that fills as you log, a table drawn as the brew sheet it replaces ('Signed off: not yet'), and a single flagged pre-boil gravity row with the brewer's note. Recognisable without the logo.
evidence.proof: 1440: operable pad in the first screen. 'Use the sample reading' through to step 8 gave 'Batch 231 record complete' and '8 of 8 readings . 1 flagged . complete'. reason: As the head brewer on a phone, B shows me the tablet screen with big keys and lets me log an off reading and see it flagged, and as the owner it shows the finished sheet with the note in the row; A only asserts the brewer side and shows a static record. Both mishandle the no-inbox constraint (A mails an invented address, B promises a reply and sends nothing), each fixable with one constant; if B's form problem were judged worse than A's invented address, or the brewer demo mattered less than A's tighter page, I would reconsider.
